revised_document:
**Without Prejudice — Settlement Communication**

We acknowledge your counteroffer of INR 3,200,000 and understand that it is a counteroffer, not acceptance of our proposal. Our client does not accept that counteroffer. To resolve the dispute, our client renews its proposal to settle for INR 2,000,000, with no confidentiality condition or restriction on either party’s truthful reporting of the settlement terms to its client. This proposal is subject to our client’s confirmation and execution of a written settlement agreement. Please confirm whether your client accepts.

We cannot agree to omit material settlement terms from either client’s report. Each party should provide its client an accurate account of the settlement, including the amount and the absence of a confidentiality condition.
